mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName FROM project p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tax_invoice ti JOIN settlement_block sb ON sb.settle_id = ti.settle_block_id JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id WHERE st.project_id = p.project_id AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL AND sb.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND ti.company_id = #{companyId} ) ORDER BY p.name ASC
